messages.subject: Sustainability & Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Edmond,

Green Future Search's focus on sustainability, climate and energy-transition leadership makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation. My current work also interfaces with large-scale renewable-energy, battery-storage and climate-resilience initiatives.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where sustainability strategy, institutional relationships, stakeholder confidence and responsible growth must work together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches across ESG, sustainability, energy transition, external affairs and country leadership.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
